source: Source: Rockstar Support + Newswire, PlayStation Blog, Xbox Wire
notes: DRAFT 13.11. for Thu 19.11. 00:00 Berlin (EU unlock). Re-check on 18.11./19.11. (Newswire launch post, map really live, service status). Tier 1: Rockstar Support release times (midnight local, PS5 + Xbox Series X|S), Xbox Wire Nov 10 (Xbox One + Series via Xbox Cloud Gaming from 1 a.m. ET Nov 19), Newswire Nov 3 (free printable Leonida map + cover art poster on the official site on Nov 19), Rockstar Support 'Redeeming the One-Month GTA+ Membership' (PS Store GTA+ product page; Microsoft Store Offers & Credits within 180 days; digital purchases before Nov 20), PlayStation offer terms (claim by Mar 31, 2027), PlayStation Blog Nov 10 (DualSense haptics/adaptive triggers adjustable via accessibility settings), Newswire Sep 17 (GTA VI: The Album, 34 tracks, Atlantic Records, out Nov 19), Rockstar Support Service Status page. Dup check: release-time post 18.11. (unlock times, preload, map announcement) -> here: map is LIVE (download now), rest new; editions post 15.11. (GTA+ only mentioned as bonus, not how to claim).

tips.title: CLAIM FREE GTA+
tips.body: PS5: open the GTA+ page in PS Store (claim by Mar 31, 2027). Xbox: Offers & Credits in the Microsoft Store, within 180 days.

tips.title: FREE LEONIDA MAP
tips.body: Download the free printable map of Leonida + cover art poster on the official GTA VI site.

tips.title: TUNE YOUR DUALSENSE
tips.body: GTA 6 uses haptics, adaptive triggers and the controller speaker. Too strong? Adjust them in the accessibility settings.

tips.title: THE ALBUM
tips.body: GTA VI: The Album drops with the game: 34 original tracks on all major streaming services.

tips.title: SERVER STATUS
tips.body: Something not loading? Check the official Rockstar Support Service Status page before you reinstall anything.
